content.Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease
Key Points: Thrombolytic therapy is used for treating prosthetic valve thrombosis.
Vitamin K can reverse warfarin effects; incorrect management can lead to bleeding issues.
Functional imaging techniques (multidetector CT, transesophageal echocardiography) are valuable for diagnosing prosthetic valve issues.
Risk assessment is crucial for mechanical and bioprosthetic valve thrombosis management.
